name: Flame Proof EOT Crane
tagline: Flame proof EOT crane for hazardous industrial environments
description: Safe Build Engineering's Flame Proof EOT Crane is designed for hazardous industrial environments requiring explosion-proof overhead crane systems. Features electromagnetic braking, heavy duty rope guides and worm gear drives for safe and reliable operation.
features: Heavy duty cast iron rope band and guide
Worm gear drives for quiet smooth operation
Available in single, twin or multiple hook models
Double speed motors for hoisting and CT motion
